convert_src = await read_file("./skills/OfficeBench/tools/word/convert_to_pdf.py")

lo_check = await run_command("which libreoffice || echo 'NOT_FOUND'")
print(lo_check)

install_fpdf = await run_command("uv pip install fpdf2")
print(install_fpdf)

import asyncio
await asyncio.sleep(5)
fpdf_verify = await run_command('python -c "from fpdf import FPDF; print(\'ok\')"')
print(fpdf_verify)

pdf_script = """\
from docx import Document
from fpdf import FPDF

doc = Document("testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

pdf = FPDF()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)
pdf.add_page()

for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if not text:
        pdf.ln(4)
        continue

    # Detect heading-like lines (customer names, title)
    if text == "Customer Activity Report":
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 16)
        pdf.cell(0, 10, text, new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
        pdf.ln(4)
    elif not text.startswith("Email:") and not text.startswith("Order ") and not text.startswith("Items:"):
        # Likely a customer name
        if any(c.isupper() for c in text) and len(text.split()) <= 4 and not text[0].isdigit():
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 12)
            pdf.cell(0, 8, text, new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
            pdf.ln(2)
        else:
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 6, text)
            pdf.ln(1)
    else:
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
        # Replace em-dash with regular dash for encoding safety
        text = text.replace("\\u2014", "-").replace("\\u2013", "-")
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 6, text)
        pdf.ln(1)

pdf.output("testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
print("PDF created successfully at testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
"""
await write_file("./create_pdf.py", pdf_script)
print("Script written")
